interest: Illuminates Imperial Japan's wartime steel metallurgy alongside early occupation policies and commercial negotiations for importing iron ore.
overview: This file documents postwar Allied policy and commercial negotiations concerning Japan's iron and steel industry alongside comprehensive technical data on its imperial-era metallurgy. It features SCAP Natural Resources Section Report No. 50, detailing raw materials, capacities, and production across Japan, Korea, and Manchuria from 1925 to 1945, accompanied by State Department correspondence regarding Far Eastern Commission pig iron allocations and American commercial efforts to supply iron ore.
